Last Piece Return.name: Last Piece Return
Last Piece Return.description: The user scatters nearly the whole body before a crushing impact, steering the pieces clear and rejoining at a safe point within the same street by the end of the user's next turn. They may bring a small carried item held by a detached hand. The pieces must have a physical route to that point; broad flames, sealed spaces or captured pieces can still harm them, and replacing losses leaves the user exhausted. Strain: severe.
